entrypoints.summary: Serialization of a value annotated with #[serde_as(as = "KeyValueMap<_>")] through serde_json::to_string or another Serde serializer; the supplied PoC invokes serde_json::to_string.

affected_components.role: The reported serialization path derives vector capacities from entry lengths; the patch changes the key-value-map capacity calculations.

code_slices.fixed: The patch replaces these with vec_with_capacity_cautious(Some(len.saturating_sub(1))) and the corresponding saturating form for an optional length.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The relevant locations are in serde_with/src/key_value_map.rs around lines 590 and 599, with additional reported sites in the same serializer implementation.
code_slices.vulnerable: KeyValueMap serializer capacity allocation used Vec::with_capacity(len - 1) or Vec::with_capacity(len.unwrap_or(17) - 1).

negative_controls: A nonempty mapped entry does not exercise the zero-length subtraction case.
No supplied artifact records an actual vulnerable or patched execution result.
observability.positive_marker: Panic during KeyValueMap serialization from the underflowing capacity calculation.

preconditions: The application serializes attacker-controlled data through #[serde_as(as = "KeyValueMap<_>")].
The supplied value contains an empty sequence or map-backed entry.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A Vec with an element wrapping an empty Vec, as in the advisory PoC.
trigger_steps.summary: Construct a KeyValueMap-annotated value containing an empty inner sequence and serialize it with serde_json::to_string.

mitigations.concept: saturating and cautious KeyValueMap capacity allocation

relation_candidates.rationale: An empty mapped entry is propagated through the documented KeyValueMap serialization path to the direct length-minus-one capacity calculation.
The advisory states that the panic can terminate the process performing serialization.

relation_candidates.dst: saturating and cautious KeyValueMap capacity allocation
relation_candidates.rationale: The patch replaces KeyValueMap direct len - 1 calculations with saturating_sub(1) and vec_with_capacity_cautious.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of the process performing serde_with KeyValueMap serialization
impact.attacker_capability: A local actor able to cause serialization of attacker-controlled data using KeyValueMap can supply an empty inner sequence or map entry and trigger the panic.

causal_trace.summary: Attacker-controlled data contains an empty sequence or map-backed entry supplied to the public KeyValueMap serialization path.

The serializer assumes every mapped element has a first field or item usable as a key, yet derives the remaining-content capacity by subtracting one from an externally visible length before establishing that it is nonzero.
For a zero length, Vec::with_capacity(len - 1), including the unwrap-or-17 form, performs an underflowing capacity calculation and panics.
The resulting panic can terminate the process that serializes the attacker-controlled value, producing a local denial of service.

failure.operation: usize subtraction in the capacity argument to Vec::with_capacity, causing a panic for an empty entry

primary_invariant.statement: A KeyValueMap serializer must not calculate remaining entry capacity as length minus one unless the subtraction is safe; zero-length entries must yield a nonnegative capacity.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The vulnerable implementations use direct subtraction in Vec::with_capacity before validating that a mapped sequence or map entry contains a first key item.

quality.review_notes: The OSV JSON supplies a concrete PoC and mechanism, and the inspected immutable patch confirms replacement of direct len - 1 capacity calculations at KeyValueMap sites. The bundle contains no captured execution result, so the process-crash oracle is a reproduction contract rather than an observed run. The OSV semver range says introduced 0 and fixed 3.21.0; the upstream-advisory preview separately displays an affected-version expression that appears inconsistent, so this record preserves the OSV range.

remediation.invariant_restored: Derived remaining-entry capacities use saturating_sub(1), and allocation is routed through vec_with_capacity_cautious rather than direct Vec::with_capacity at the patched KeyValueMap sites.

oracle.expected_negative: On the patched implementation, the same zero-length capacity derivation uses saturating_sub(1) and cautious allocation rather than the direct underflowing subtraction.
oracle.expected_positive: On an affected release, serializing a KeyValueMap value containing an empty inner sequence or map entry reaches the reported panic condition.
